items.name: Alice's Ribbon
items.description:
Ribbon left behind by Alice.
Search for not yet known Alice in a dream.

items.name: Black Ash
items.description:
Consumes all held souls and returns to Holy Forest.
"Revive as much as you need to experience this tale."

items.name: Fairy's Wing
items.description:
Increases Speed of the target ally for some time.
"They cry and scream, but aren't they immortal anyway?"

items.name: Feather of Immortal Bird
items.description:
Revive a fallen ally. "Enraged by the haughty
phoenix, God plucked its wings clean."

items.name: Succubus Fluids
items.description:
Weakens the target enemy. "Are succubi a dream?
Or maybe they're real?"

items.name: Lilith's Heart
items.description:
Wrongwrongwrong, can't become ***'s ****, no.
Need to produce more charming, lovely girls.

items.name: Winter Gift
items.description:
Merry Christmas!
And Happy New Year!

items.name: Large Black Soul
items.description: Greatly increases all parameters. "Mother's love, is it so warm? Can even I understand it?"
items.japaneseDescription:
Greatly increases all parameters. "Mother's love,
is it so warm? Can even I understand it?"

items.name: Tainted Black Soul
items.description:
Increases all parameters. "Soul I raised
personally. Want to get a taste?-Arbiter Hein"

items.name: Fluffy's Costume
items.description:
Turn into Fluffy inside Room of Reminiscence.
※Will not make you move faster.

items.name: Dung Pie EX
items.description: Poison the target enemy.

items.name: Fairy-tale[Hansel&Gretel]
items.description:
Tale of siblings abandoned by mother in famine. Eating
mushrooms the two hallucinate a house made of cake.

items.name: Fairy-tale[Three Little Pigs]
items.description:
The monster the three pigs raised escaped and devoured
them. Hyena of hunger settled in the destroyed ranch.

items.name: Fairy-tale[King's New Clothes]
items.description:
There was a king clad in an impregnable iron armor.
But being a hindrance for lust, the armor was unseen.

items.name: Fairy-tale[Knight in Armor]
items.description:
Meow-meow-meow, we're strong.
Meow-meow-meow, we're knight.

items.name: Fairy-tale[Dog of Elixir]
items.description:
Faithful dog protected beloved owner. From beasts.
From disease. And so it was sacrificed by fools.

items.name: Fairy-tale[Singing Bone]
items.description:
♪You are blowing your horn with one of my bones. My brother
slew me, and gained the princess by pretending 'twas he.

items.name: Fairy-tale[Pied Piper of Elixir]
items.description:
Persecuted for poverty and exiled, the man got revenge
by leading rats to spread disease, destroying the city.

items.name: Fairy-tale[Musicians of Bremen]
items.description:
Abused, animals swear to take revenge on humans. The
music they play is violent, ghastly, and yet artistic.

items.name: Fairy-tale[Ugly Duckling]
items.description: This duck had a family. But the war took everything from him, leaving only bloodlust. Now, he only seeks more conflict.
items.japaneseDescription:
This duck had a family. But the war took everything from him,
leaving only bloodlust. Now, he only seeks more conflict.

items.name: Fairy-tale[Jack and Beanstalk]
items.description:
Poor boy was abandoned by his mother with some beans.
Starving, he ate them and grew huge in a blink of an eye.

items.name: Fairy-tale[Peter Pan]
items.description:
Peter Pan will come for kids who stay up late. Forever
he'll lock them in his prison. Even now he may be outside…

items.name: Fairy-tale[Adventures of Sinbad]
items.description:
For thousand nights Sinbad sailed through the seven seas.
His humanity is gone, yet his adventures will continue.

items.name: Fairy-tale[Alladin and Wonderful Lamp]
items.description:
Demon said "I'll grant any one your desires".
And Alladin replied "Then hand over your power".
items.japaneseDescription:
Demon said 「I'll grant any one your desires」.
And Alladin replied 「Then hand over your power」.

items.name: Fairy-tale[King with Donkey Ears]
items.description:
With the truth exposed, the king rages. Consigning servants
and people to death, he soon brings ruin to the country.

items.name: Fairy-tale[Iron Hans]
items.description:
Do not release him, for he is a weapon of slaughter.
And yet the ignorance prince set free the Iron Hans.

items.name: Fairy-tale[Beauty and Beast]
items.description:
Using the beast, the beauty obtained fortune and station.
The beast yearned for her love, no matter how fake.

items.name: Fairy-tale [Tortoise and Hare]
items.description:
Two insane knights. Comrades in timeless rivalry.
"Let us compete. Who will kill, rape, and cheat more?"
items.japaneseDescription:
Two insane knights. Comrades in timeless rivalry.
「Let us compete. Who will kill, rape, and cheat more?」

items.name: Fairy-tale[Little Match Girl]
items.description:
Mother said. This Match will show a wonderful dream.
How you make it? With the flesh of women from here…….

items.name: Fairy-tale[Alice in Wonderland]
items.description:
Alice noticed it. This wonderful world is fake.
All nothing more than a wild delusion……even I.

items.name: Fairy-tale[Wizard of Oz]
items.description:
With three servants I've killed countless witches.
Soon enough I'll be the greatest wizard of all.

items.name: Fairy-tale [Jeanne d'Arc]
items.description:
Why people war? Why is humanity so ugly? I cannot
believe in God anymore. So thought witch in the fire.

items.name: Fairy-tale[Golden Goose]
items.description:
That bird can give an ordinary man vast riches.
That bird will suddenly get bored and fly away.

items.name: Fairy-tale[Saint of Alexandria]
items.description:
From the deepest faith comes doubt in God's existence.
The world has come to this, is where God in it?

items.name: Fairy-tale[Pinocchio]
items.description:
Human structure can be improved. Nature is imperfect.
So muttered Pinocchio, dissecting yet another corpse.

items.name: Fairy-tale[Rapunzel]
items.description:
Girl with a charming golden hair rules minds and bodies.
Entranced, many men submit to her, building a kingdom.

items.name: Fairy-tale[Princess Frog]
items.description:
The prince dropped his shoe into a bog. Huge toad jumped
out and kissed him, killed him. Ah…and he was my prince.

items.name: Fairy-tale[Little Mermaid]
items.description: The mermaid fell in love with the prince. Unrequited, that love soon consumed the prince's country in a tsunami.
items.japaneseDescription:
The mermaid fell in love with the prince. Unrequited,
that love soon consumed the prince's country in a tsunami.

items.name: Fairy-tale[Snow White]
items.description:
Jealous of beauty, queen stepmother tried to kill
Snow White. And she did the same, wanting the same.

items.name: Fairy-tale[Cinderella]
items.description:
Ash-clad princess invites dreaming women to a ball.
And in exchange for dreams she takes their souls…….

items.name: Fairy-tale[Queen Elisabeth]
items.description:
Tyrannic queen had a hobby of torturing servants and
daughters of nobles. Her favorite was "Iron Maiden".
items.japaneseDescription:
Tyrannic queen had a hobby of torturing servants and
daughters of nobles. Her favorite was 「Iron Maiden」.

items.name: Fairy-tale[North Wind and Sun]
items.description:
One day the wind fought with the sun. For three days
and nights typhoons and blazes ruined the land.

items.name: Fairy-tale[Little Red Riding Hood]
items.description:
Smeared in blood*****hood***created****wolf********
****fantasy*******what number does that make her***

Soul healing. The amount restored scales with
the caster's Magic.

items.description:
Pour soul arrows upon all enemies.
The power scales with the caster's Magic.

items.description: Cancel all stat buffs on the target enemy.

items.description: Deal unavoidable damage to the target enemy.

items.description: Restore MP at the cost of HP.

items.description: Blind all enemies.

items.name: Sorcery[Sleep]
items.description: Put all enemies to sleep.

Cure all ailments with the exceptions of
faint from the target ally.

items.name: Sorcery[Blessing of Magic]
items.description: Increases Magic of the user.

items.description:
Automatically protect low-HP allies
for some time.

items.name: Sorcery[Conceal]
items.description: Makes the user less likely to be targeted.

items.name: Miracle[Raise]

items.description: Cancel all debuffs on the target ally.

items.description: Restore HP of all allies.

so that they can revive once if slain.

items.name: Sorcery[Silence Bubble]

items.name: Sorcery[Dark Side Moon]
items.description: Drain HP of the target enemy.

items.name: Sorcery[Frozen Magic Bullet]
items.description: Rain hail upon 3 enemies and freeze them.

items.name: Sorcery[Conflagration]
items.description: Throughly burn all enemies and set them on fire.

items.name: Sorcery[Ruinous Storm]
items.description: Summon 6 Ruinous Storms to deal pure damage.

items.description:
Greatly increase Magic for some time.
During the effect HP keeps decreasing.
